thread:
PagerBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: eu-central1 GPU pool queue growth detected. pool_util=96%, queue=2.4k reqs, recent scale-up attempts failing with quota errors. auto-scaler state=PROVISIONING_LIMBO. see /ops/alerts/4523456789
Oncall SRE: Ack. I'm on it — switching channel to this thread for coordination.
Infra Lead: I'm seeing repeated GCE quota errors: "RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Insufficient quota for resource 'GPUS'" from the provisioner. Opening cloud console now.
Amanda Chen: We're starting to get customer reports for slow requests (p50 lag spiking). Which customers are hit?
Jordan Reyes: Early signals from prod-ml-job queue show low-priority batch jobs piling up; latency-sensitive inference also affected for a subset of keys.
Sanjay Patel: I just opened a GCP support case (case/GP-2026-9987) and pasted logs. ETA on human response unknown.
Oncall SRE: Immediate mitigations: 1) divert new low-priority traffic to eu-west1; 2) scale down concurrency for hosted-tenants in eu-central1; 3) serve degraded model (quantized) for non-SLA tiers. Who can push routing?
Liam O'Connor: I can flip the routing rule. Will do a quick canary to 5% first.
OpsBot: Executing runbook step: throttling ingress at edge LB for route /v1/generate (rate=60rps -> 30rps)
Oncall SRE: Good. Liam, after canary, push to 50% if metrics look sane. Also, Amanda, please draft a short customer note for impacted customers. Keep it factual and mention mitigation.
Amanda Chen: Drafting now. Short note: "We're experiencing elevated inference latency in eu-central1 due to GPU provisioning issues. We've diverted traffic and are applying mitigations; some requests may see degraded models. We'll post updates." Want me to post to status.redwood.ai?
Customer Success: Yes please post to status and ping the top 3 customers on the incident list. Add mention of potential tokenization regressions with quantized models.
Infra Lead: Quick update: quota is hitting project-level hard cap for GPUs in eu-central1 (region limit), not a transient pool exhaustion. GCP report: "Quota limit reached for accelerators (n1)". Manual quota increase request is pending.
Oncall SRE: Ok — treat as scale-up stall due to region limit. Alternative: provision spare nodes in eu-west1 and shift capacity. Jordan, can we remap some scheduled batch jobs to west region?
Jordan Reyes: Yes. I'll drain jobs from eu-central1 and resubmit to eu-west1 cluster. Expecting ~12 minutes to fully remap backlog.
Sanjay Patel: GCP support responded: they see the quota request but note multi-project quota sharing could complicate fast increase. They're suggesting temporary use of a different accelerator type (A100->T4) if that works.
Oncall SRE: Can we tolerate T4 for lower-precision variants? Liam, any constraints on serving stack?
Liam O'Connor: We have T4-optimized runtime but throughput will be ~0.4x for same model. We can spin up T4 pools and route non-SLA traffic there. Doing that now.
OpsBot: Command executed: ```terraform apply -target=module.eu_west1.t4_pool``` — pool started (10 nodes)
Oncall SRE: Nice. After T4 pool ready, do a staged rollout: 10% -> 30% -> 100 for non-SLA traffic. Monitor p95 and error rates.
Amanda Chen: Status page update posted. Customer Success notified top impacted accounts. Customer question: any ETA for full resolution (eu-central quotas)?
Infra Lead: No firm ETA on quota expansion. GCP support gave no SLA. We're treating eu-central as degraded until quota increases.
Sanjay Patel: Added a follow-up: if quota increase doesn't land in 6 hours, Ops should plan a sustained cross-region routing policy and sales should be looped for affected contracts.
Jordan Reyes: Backlog remapping at 40% complete. Queue size trending down from 2400 -> 900.
Oncall SRE: Good trend. Next steps: 1) keep T4 fallback for low-priority traffic; 2) keep canary routing; 3) prepare a rollback plan if errors spike; 4) document mitigation in the incident tracker. Assigning follow-ups: Infra Lead -> continue quota chase; Liam -> finish routing rollout; Amanda -> customer comms; Jordan -> backlog remap.
Liam O'Connor: 50% staged rollout to T4 pool done. p95 for canary is +120ms, errors stable. Proceeding to 100% for non-SLA.
Customer Success: Customers acknowledged the note; one enterprise rep asked for a more detailed RCA and mitigation timeline.
Oncall SRE: Copy. We'll capture timeline and technical root cause for RCA (region hard cap + lack of spare accelerator types in region). Draft to follow.
Infra Lead: Logging ticket for longer-term remediation: increase regional buffer pool, improve cross-region autoscaler fallback, and add accelerator-type fallback to the autoscaler.
Oncall SRE: Closing thread for live mitigation — moving to postmortem channel for RCA and action items. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
